headline: California bars AI-only firings; DeepMind watermarks AI-designed proteins
body: A modestly brighter day. California became the first US state to bar employers from firing or disciplining workers solely through automated systems, requiring human corroboration and notice. Keeping humans in the loop lowers AI Autonomy and supports Shared Prosperity, which helps Egalitarian Utopia while trimming Conquerors, Descendants and Zookeeper. Google DeepMind published SynthID Bio in Nature, a way to watermark AI-designed proteins for biosecurity tracing; it lowers Catastrophic Risk, easing Self-Destruction. Neither story was dramatic, but both pointed toward safer, more human-checked use of AI. Horizon Balance rose to -12.20.
movers_note: Self-Destruction -0.3 (SynthID Bio -0.33), Conquerors -0.3 (SB 947 -0.24, SynthID Bio -0.09) and Egalitarian Utopia +0.3 (SB 947 +0.17, SynthID Bio +0.12).
